text:
kai: heads up — noticed an egress fanout splay from apac-edge -> eu-backbone starting ~1712567800. 5 tenants got routed into dedicated fallback pools simultaneously, cost spiked and p99 shot up. anyone seen similar? :thinking:

sylvia: saw a jump in our egress tail traces, looks like the fanout multiplier increased for short-lived flows

raj: rough logs? can you paste a brief sample?

kai: paste of truncated log:```
2026-04-05T10:04:12Z ROUTER route_change tenant=tn-842 old=hosted new=dedicated reason=egress_fanout_splay multiplier=5
2026-04-05T10:04:13Z PROXY conn=xyz tenant=tn-842 upstream_delay_ms=240 p99=1.2s
```

kai: also see many small parallel connections from the same tenant causing KV-cache misses -> more upstream calls

infra-bot: alert: egress_fanout_splay detected in apac-edge, affected_tenants=5, suggested_action=limit-fanout|pin-to-warm-pool

maria: FYI this matches a recent client pattern (small concurrent inference requests from mobile SDK) — they opened a support ticket earlier today

raj: two quick checks: 1) confirm soft-quota routing thresholds didn't misfire, 2) check warm-pool prefetch exhaustion. run: `rgwctl check warmpool --region=apac-edge --since=10m`

kai: running that now, tail:```
warmpool.available=8
warmpool.request_rate=420/s
warmpool.prefetch_misses=62
```

sylvia: prefetch_misses=62 over 10m is high for that pool — likely the root cause (fanout causing many cold slots)

maria: short-term mitigation: can we throttle per-tenant fanout at the proxy so clients don't open >3 parallel upstreams? that should reduce multiplier and cost

raj: agree. propose patch to proxy: enforce `max_parallel_upstreams=3` for mobile sdk user-agent and add temporary routing rule to prefer local warm pools. Would need a 5-minute deploy window.

kai: :+1: also suggest rollback path: auto-unpin after 10m and metrics backfill

infra-bot: action logged: create-ticket id=EGF-482 pin-tenant=tn-842 to-warmpool=true throttle-rule=mobile-sdk-max3

sylvia: followup note — we should audit routing multipliers. this 'splay' behavior looks like an exponential backoff bug where multiplier resets only after 30m.

raj: filing a short postmortem checklist item: audit multiplier reset logic, add unit test for multiplier decay, and add a canary to limit warmpool prefetch_misses alerts

maria: I'll reach out to the client about SDK changes and temporary rate limits.

kai: thanks team — I'll run the throttle deploy in 5 and post updates here. :white_check_mark:

(six minutes later)
kai: deploy done, throttling in place, initial signals: affected_tenants dropped to 0, warmpool.prefetch_misses -> 4 in last 5m, cost spike cooling off. keeping watch for 30m. :eyes:
